people: October 2026 roster with member headshots; link the lab scheduler

- 19 new member records from the owner's roster list (D-12); 21 consented
  headshots from the 'Submit a headshot' form, cropped to 480x480 with all
  metadata stripped; placeholders for Aaron Tu (submitted an ID card),
  Vinayak Sarkar (silhouette) and William Deng (none).
- Eddie Zhang, Hannah Yu, Marcus Koh, Ryan Xu -> alumni 2026 (not on the
  October roster; to confirm). Display name William Deng per the roster.
- New site.yml member_links (schema + CMS 'Links for lab members'): Lab
  scheduler -> https://scheduler.bobalab.org/, shown in the footer and on
  /people/. Link only; the scheduler forbids framing.
- D-11: content/ is now the source of truth; the dataset importer is retired.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

content: publish all imported entries (owner decision D-10)

Owner chose 'Publish everything' for the live site. The importer now
writes draft: false for every entry (PUBLISH_ALL), except the one project
with no research direction (cancer-recognition), which stays a draft so no
direction is invented. Consent gates are unchanged: listed:false people,
photos, emails and 'now at' remain hidden. site.yml launched stays false
until CMS sign-in is configured.

Tests: CON-02 hold skipped while PUBLISH_ALL is on; hidden-names scan gets
a 60 s timeout (OneDrive I/O). validate 72/72, unit 670 pass, export check ok.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

verify(content): idempotent importer, drafted PI-reported news, program labels, citation names, wording

- CON-01: every integration fix lives in scripts/import; --check is clean (115 files)
- CON-02: news about PI-reported journal decisions are drafts until the papers are public
- CON-04 / VIS-06: program labels in display casing, no invented expansions
- CON-07 / CON-08 / CON-09 / CON-13 / CON-14 / VIS-13: one PI citation name, no "the PI",
  Tuck and MSOM news corrected, event names spelled out, copy fixes, one "Archived"
- CNT-01: site.yml notes moved from YAML comments to editors_note
- publications-2: four PI-reported awards carry source: self-reported (D11 updated)
- CON-16 deferred: archived_on is the import month until the lab decides (C3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

integration: apply change requests

Applies the WP1-WP8 change requests to WP0-owned files (and the few cross-package ones), marks each request with its status, and regenerates the wordmark, golden citations, media manifest and CMS admin files.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

WP7: content import, media pipeline, content audit and PI questions

- scripts/import: re-runnable importer from the research dataset (kept
  outside the repo) to content/** per docs/CONTENT-MAPPING.md and D-03..D-06;
  dry-run / --write / --check, Prettier-formatted output, known-fix asserts
- content/: 6 directions, 25 publications, 18 projects, 35 people,
  19 news, 5 opportunities, site.yml and 5 pages (drafts per D-03)
- scripts/media/build-images.mjs: sharp 480/960 WebP variants + manifest,
  10 MB limit, prune, --check; handles an empty uploads folder
- tests: salted-hash guard for hidden-only roster names, importer helpers,
  media pipeline, production vs preview content modes
- docs: CONTENT-AUDIT.md (sanitized), CONTENT-QUESTIONS.md, WP7 change request

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
